title: Fallen world public smp
description: Public smp for the fallen world modpack
body:
An offical server for the modpack fallen world hosted by the creator(jalnyr). You are free to do anything in the server while following these rules.
1. Don't use hacks. Using hacks will get you banned.
2. Pvp is enabled and killing is allowed
3. Griefing is also allowed but don't use x-ray when finding bases
4. Be nice to everyone
